message:
Initial import

author: Tobias Ferreira
tobias@kilnhq.dev
message:
Derive cache keys from manifest contents

A key is the first 16 hex digits of a SHA-256 over the manifest's canonical JSON, so the
same target gets the same key on every machine. Adds the kiln command (key, put, get,
prune) and docs/cache-keys.md.

author: Tobias Ferreira
tobias@kilnhq.dev
message:
Sort target inputs before hashing

Two manifests listing the same inputs in another order got different keys and missed the
cache. This changes existing keys, so the format moves to kiln/2.

author: Tobias Ferreira
tobias@kilnhq.dev
message:
Move canonical JSON into kiln.canonical

kiln-remote needs the same encoding to check uploads, so it gets its own module.
fingerprint keeps the key rules.
